shortDescription: Russia's Nornickel RUS:GMKN, the world's largest palladium producer and a major producer of refined nickel, said on Monday that its third-quarter nickel and palladium output increased quarter-on-quarter.• Nickel production totalled 61,000 metric tons in the third quarter, up 41% quarter-on-quarter…

children: , the world's largest palladium producer and a major producer of refined nickel, said on Monday that its third-quarter nickel and palladium output increased quarter-on-quarter.
• Nickel production totalled 61,000 metric tons in the third quarter, up 41% quarter-on-quarter.
• Palladium output rose 25% quarter-on-quarter to 736,000 ounces in the third quarter.
• Third-quarter copper production increased 4% to 127,000 tons.
• The company confirmed its 2026 production forecast of 193,000-203,000 metric tons of nickel and 2.415 million-2.465 million ounces of palladium.
